title: Degen Watch
tagline: Degen Watch snap is a tool that helps to customize your on-chain experience with real-time data. The snap uses real time database of blockchain scanner provider and provide user with token insights at a glance on the MetaMask wallet.
description:
Degen Watch is an analytical Snap extension for the MetaMask wallet. It consists of a Snap for the wallet itself and a companion web app. The goal of the Degen Watch Snap is to display on-chain analytics for a selected token before a user executes a transaction. The web application offers extended functionality where users can customize the data displayed in the Snap, view live price charts, and transaction history.

In the future, it will be possible to combine data from various sources and display them within the wallet.
how_its_made:
To build the project, we used the MetaMask Snap SDK as the foundation. We obtained price and liquidity data from the open-source API WhatToFarm. In the companion web app, we utilized TradingView widgets to visually represent price charts in a user-friendly format. On the frontend, we integrated several components from Material UI for configuring display settings and viewing transaction history.
